pe_prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Ultra-realistic live-action, cinematic, vertical composition, a single continuous take begins exactly from <Picture 1>: the same woman with long wavy blue-grey hair, silver-blue crown, jeweled choker and arm cuffs, barefoot with jeweled ankle piece, wearing the iridescent blue-green corset gown with high leg slit and flowing watery train, mid-stride facing the camera on the runway of a grand gothic hall, while the massive ice-blue crystalline dragon with glowing pale eyes, spread wings and forward-reaching claws looms symmetrically behind her; seated elegant audience in dark formal attire lines both sides, chandeliers and blue light columns glow in the background, with two audience members filming on phones in the foreground. The woman advances very rapidly down the runway toward the camera with a fluid, natural, accelerated x2-like gait, no slow motion, the dress train and water-like splashes trailing dynamically behind her; the dragon follows immediately behind at a similar fast, elegant, controlled pace, wings slightly folding as it moves forward. The camera follows the movement smoothly in one continuous take, starting frontal, shifting to a side angle as she passes, then returning to a frontal angle. At around 3.5 seconds she reaches the end of the runway, stops, and strikes two short stylized poses — a hand on her hip, then a turn with her chin lifted — while the dragon halts behind her in a majestic stance with wings partially raised. The audience watches; both characters' appearances remain identical to the reference frame throughout, with no speech and no on-screen text.

overall_soundscape: Fast clicking footsteps of heels on the runway and the heavy measured claws of the dragon striking the floor, with fluid splashes from the trailing gown, a low reverberant hall ambience, and the murmur and phone-clicks of the elegant audience.

non_diegetic_music: Royal, regal orchestral score at a brisk tempo — blazing brass fanfare, timpani rolls and sweeping strings — building through the walk and holding a majestic peak as she poses at the end.
